references.text: Describes Benjamin's border as including Beth-hoglah and Beth-arabah, the same places mentioned in Joshua's border description for Judah.
Mentions Bohan's stone, son of Reuben, as a boundary marker, the same landmark used in Judah's border description.
Beth-arabah is mentioned as one of the cities in Judah's wilderness area, confirming the location noted in the border description.
